unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U17: Identify government,foreign,holding and subsidiary relationships

payload.title: Control, location and government ownership answer different questions
payload.core_explanation_md:
The government-company definition uses not less than fifty-one per cent of paid-up share capital held by the described Central/State government combination and includes a subsidiary of such a government company. Do not replace paid-up capital with revenue or the number of government-appointed employees.

A foreign-company analysis considers foreign incorporation together with the statutory Indian place-of-business and business-activity requirements, including the described electronic presence. Holding/subsidiary relationships require the relevant board-composition or voting-power control test and can extend down a subsidiary chain. Common branding or a minority investment alone does not establish the relationship. Use the current statutory control wording rather than the textbook shorthand of majority shares for every capital structure.

self_check.prompt_text: Can common branding alone prove a subsidiary relationship?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Establish the applicable control test.

payload.stem_md: The Central and State Governments together hold the required fifty-one per cent of paid-up capital. A note tests government-company status by annual sales instead. What is wrong?

options.text_md: Sales must always equal share capital
Only one government may hold any shares
options.explanation_md: The definition permits the described combination.

options.text_md: The statutory ownership measure is paid-up share capital
options.explanation_md: Revenue is not the stated test.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Revenue is not the stated test.

payload.stem_md: A lender sees a group logo and assumes a subsidiary guarantee is automatically a holding-company guarantee. What must be checked?

options.text_md: Separate entity identity, control relationship and the actual undertaking
options.explanation_md: Group relationship does not merge obligations.

options.text_md: A rule that all group debts are automatically joint

payload.correct_explanation_md: Group relationship does not merge obligations.
